07014 Qayin {kah'-yin}

與 07013 同 (與 07069 有相似之處);
   TWOT - 2017,2016

欽定本 - Cain 17, Kenite 1; 18

陽性專有名詞
該隱 = "擁有"
1) 亞當和夏娃最大的兒子, 人類第一位謀殺者, 他殺了自己的兄弟亞伯
種族名稱
基尼 = "鐵匠"
2) 摩西的岳父所屬的部落名稱, 此部落位於巴勒斯坦南邊和西奈山之間 （#民 24:22|）
record.edic_text:
07014 Qayin {kah'-yin}

the same as 07013 (with a play upon the affinity to 07069);
   TWOT - 2017,2016

AV - Cain 17, Kenite 1; 18

n pr m
Cain = "possession"
1) eldest son of Adam and Eve and the first murderer having murdered
   his brother Abel
n pr gent
Kenite = "smiths"
2) the tribe from which the father-in-law of Moses was a member and
   which lived in the area between southern Palestine and the mountains
   of Sinai
